python.name: CPython
python.approvalEvidence: Official PSF license retained through the generated SBOM notice field.
obligations: Retain the PSF license and copyright notice with the binary distribution.

pyinstaller.approvalEvidence: PyInstaller bootloader exception reviewed against the official COPYING.txt source.
obligations: Retain the PyInstaller license and bootloader exception notice.

pyside6-essentials.name: PySide6-Essentials
pyside6-essentials.approvalEvidence: Read from the wheel metadata rather than a trove classifier: pyside6_essentials-6.11.2.dist-info/METADATA declares "License: LGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only", and the only licence file the wheel embeds is licenses/LicenseRef-Qt-Commercial.txt, which applies to commercial licensees only. This project takes the LGPL-3.0-only arm, which is what allows an MIT application to distribute a combined binary. That closes the PyQt6 question: Riverbank offered only GPL-3.0-only or a paid entitlement, neither of which the MIT licence selects.
obligations: Ship the LGPL-3.0 license text and the Qt notices with every artifact.
Keep AstraDownloader-onedir.zip published alongside the one-file executable: it is the artifact that leaves the Qt libraries replaceable, which is how the relinking right is honoured.
Record the exact wheel version so the corresponding Qt source for that build can be pointed at.

shiboken6.name: shiboken6
shiboken6.approvalEvidence: shiboken6-6.11.2.dist-info/METADATA carries the same tri-licence declaration as PySide6-Essentials and the same commercial-only embedded licence file. It is the binding runtime PySide6 imports, so it takes the same LGPL-3.0-only arm.
obligations: Ship the LGPL-3.0 license text and the Qt notices with every artifact.
Keep AstraDownloader-onedir.zip published alongside the one-file executable: it is the artifact that leaves the Qt libraries replaceable, which is how the relinking right is honoured.
Record the exact wheel version so the corresponding Qt source for that build can be pointed at.

blinker.approvalEvidence: Wheel declares the license only through a trove classifier, which the resolver deliberately refuses to guess from. Read from the embedded blinker-1.9.0.dist-info/LICENSE.txt: the MIT permission grant and warranty disclaimer, Copyright 2010 Jason Kirtland.
obligations: Retain the MIT license and copyright notice with the binary distribution.

colorama.approvalEvidence: Classifier says only "BSD License", which does not select a clause count. Read from the embedded colorama-0.4.6.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE.txt: three conditions including the "Neither the name ... nor the names of its contributors" endorsement clause, Copyright (c) 2010 Jonathan Hartley.
obligations: Retain the BSD copyright notice, conditions, and disclaimer.
Do not use the copyright holder's or contributors' names to endorse this product without written permission.

itsdangerous.approvalEvidence: Classifier says only "BSD License". Read from the embedded itsdangerous-2.2.0.dist-info/LICENSE.txt: three conditions including the endorsement clause, Copyright 2011 Pallets.
obligations: Retain the BSD copyright notice, conditions, and disclaimer.
Do not use the copyright holder's or contributors' names to endorse this product without written permission.

jinja2.approvalEvidence: Classifier says only "BSD License". Read from the embedded jinja2-3.1.6.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE.txt: three conditions including the endorsement clause, Copyright 2007 Pallets.
obligations: Retain the BSD copyright notice, conditions, and disclaimer.
Do not use the copyright holder's or contributors' names to endorse this product without written permission.

packaging.approvalEvidence: Wheel declares License-Expression: Apache-2.0 OR BSD-2-Clause and ships both texts (LICENSE.APACHE, LICENSE.BSD). A disjunction is not auto-approvable even when every branch is, because choosing the branch is a distribution decision: this build takes the Apache-2.0 branch, whose notice and NOTICE-retention terms are the ones recorded below.
obligations: Retain the Apache-2.0 license text and attribution notices with the binary distribution.
State that the Apache-2.0 branch of the dual license is the one exercised.

runtimeHelpers.name: yt-dlp.exe
obligations: Record the resolved release version and SHA-256, and ship the executable's THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES plus GPL corresponding-source route.
runtimeHelpers.resolution: The moving latest URL must be resolved to an exact release and digest for each companion release.

runtimeHelpers.name: FFmpeg GPL build
obligations: Record the resolved build version and SHA-256, identify the exact configured license, retain notices, and provide corresponding source for the distributed GPL build.
runtimeHelpers.resolution: The moving master build and its corresponding source/notice bundle must be frozen per companion release.

runtimeHelpers.name: Deno runtime
obligations: Record the resolved release version and SHA-256 and retain the MIT notice.
runtimeHelpers.resolution: The moving latest URL must be resolved to an exact release and digest for each companion release.

runtimeHelpers.name: QuickJS-ng runtime
runtimeHelpers.approvalEvidence: MIT notice retained through the generated SBOM notice field; the release is pinned to an exact tag and SHA-256 in astra_downloader.py, so the resolved version and digest are fixed rather than moving.
obligations: Retain the MIT license and copyright notice with the runtime.
runtimeHelpers.resolution: None outstanding. Unlike the other helpers this URL is already an exact release; quickjs-ng publishes no checksum asset, so the digest is pinned in source and bumping the version requires bumping it in the same commit.
